Gujarat, owing to its inherent strength of widespread entrepreneurial spirit has gained a significant spot in the national startup ecosystem. The incentives to Startups under the Gujarat Industrial Policy 2015 have supported in the creation of a strong network of nodal institutions and several startups have expanded their operations\\\\/ products both at the national and international levels.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><h4><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h4><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The Quantum of Assistance as under would be provided to the Startups whose innovative project is approved\\\\/sanctioned by SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Sustenance Allowance:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">A sustenance allowance of \\\\u20b9 20,000 per month per startup will be provided to the Startups for a period of one year.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">If startups have at least one woman co-founder, \\\\u20b9 25,000 per month per startup will be provided as a sustenance allowance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed Support:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed support up to \\\\u20b9 30,00,000 will be provided to the Startups on the following, based on approval\\\\/ sanction by SLEC:<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">1. Cost of raw materials\\\\/consumables\\\\/hardware &amp; software\\\\/professional services \\\\/other equipment\\\\/ tools required for prototype\\\\/product\\\\/process development<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">2. Market research Testing &amp; Trials<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">3. Marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance: Here marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance covers assistance to startups to attend national\\\\/international events. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible under this head. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">[<\\\\/span><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Note:<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered for assistance]<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups having a Significant Impact on Society:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Additional support of upto \\\\u20b9 10,00,000 assistance will be provided to startups having innovative projects which have a significant impact on society, based on the conditions on approval\\\\/ sanction given by the SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Pre-Series A funding:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">In the life cycle of a Startup, there is a funding gap which is better identified as the valley of death. This is a phase post commercialization where the Startup has just started generating revenue till the time period where its product\\\\/service gets market traction. Such startups will be assisted in getting venture capital. Initially, to support, such mid-level Pre-series A funding to startups, a separate fund shall be created under Gujarat Venture Finance Limited (GVFL). This assistance will be specifically to cater to the startups that have already received seed support from the government under various schemes for the promotion of startups.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Interest subsidy:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The startups that have been approved\\\\/sanctioned under this scheme will be eligible to avail of an additional interest subsidy of 1%, a maximum of up to 9% on term loans under the provisions of the scheme for assistance to MSMEs.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to enroll and participate in Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance up to \\\\u20b9 3,00,000 per startup will be provided to enroll and participate in the national \\\\/ internationally recognized acceleration program. Approved\\\\/sanctioned startups will be eligible for assistance up to \\\\u20b9 3,00,000 per startup during the operative period of the scheme, to enroll\\\\/participate in a national\\\\/internationally recognized acceleration program. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible for getting assistance. However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered under this assistance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">An acceleration program is typically a 3-4 month program for startups at the early traction and scaling stage. It is a process of intense, rapid, and immersive education aimed at accelerating the growth of the startup.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance for Skill Development:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Approved\\\\/sanctioned startups shall be provided assistance for skill development training specific to soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills for the startup project. Such skill development training should support the startups in understanding the ecosystem, fundraising, commercializing, and scaling up the startup project. Financial assistance up to Rs. 1 lakh per approved\\\\/sanctioned startup shall be given for participating in such skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><h4><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to the Approved\\\\/Sanctioned Nodal Institution<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h4><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Mentoring Assistance:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Mentoring Assistance of \\\\u20b9 1,00,000 per approved\\\\/sanctioned startup shall be provided to Nodal institution for the mentoring service (Maximum \\\\u20b9 15,00,000 per annum per institute.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Reimbursement Expenses on Organizing Promotional Events:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Reimbursement of 75% of expenses incurred for organizing promotional events to the extent of a maximum \\\\u20b9 5,00,000. If the event being organized is specific to \\\\\"Women Entrepreneurship\\\\\", the Nodal Institution will be eligible for reimbursement of 90% of expenses incurred for organizing promotional events to the extent of a maximum \\\\u20b9 5,00,000. However, it is clarified that the beneficiary Nodal Institution will not be eligible to get assistance under any other scheme of Govt. of Gujarat for the same component\\\\/purpose.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Other Support:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">1. Govt. will support approved\\\\/ sanctioned Startups to get free access to universities\\\\/ Libraries\\\\/ Govt. Laboratories\\\\/ SDCs (GIDC) \\\\/ Center of Excellence \\\\/ PSUs to support and facilitate innovative ideas\\\\/concepts.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">2. For organizing Acceleration Programs in Gujarat any institution, would be assisted by providing financial assistance, as approved by SLEC, maximum up to the matching contribution to the expenditure incurred.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">3. The project is entitled to avail of other benefits under the schemes for assistance to MSMEs.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Eligibility <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">For Startups:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><ol><li data-list=\\\\\"ordered\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Any individual\\\\/group of individuals having an innovative idea\\\\/concept and recommended by an approved Nodal Institution will be eligible to get recognized as a startup under this scheme. <\\\\/span><\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"ordered\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The innovative project can be from any sector or any faculty\\\\/branch of science\\\\/ technology\\\\/ engineering\\\\/ agriculture\\\\/ healthcare and no innovation worth its name is restricted from availing assistance just because of its being in a particular sector, making this a sector agnostic scheme.<\\\\/span><\\\\/li><\\\\/ol><p><br><\\\\/p><p><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Note 1:<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> An entity formed by splitting up or reconstruction of an existing business shall not be considered a \\'Startup\\'.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Note 2: <\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The startups which are availing incentives as a \\'startup\\' in any other \\'startup scheme\\' of the Government of Gujarat will not get incentives under this scheme. class=\\\\\"ql-editor read-mode\\\\\"><h3><a href=\\\\\"https:\\\\/\\\\/www.myscheme.gov.in\\\\/schemes\\\\/sfasisd#details\\\\\" rel=\\\\\"noopener noreferrer\\\\\">Details<\\\\/a><\\\\/h3><p>The \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups\\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.<\\\\/p><p>The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills. This initiative aims to enable startups to better understand the ecosystem, raise funds, commercialize their ideas, and scale up their projects.<\\\\/p><h3><a href=\\\\\"https:\\\\/\\\\/www.myscheme.gov.in\\\\/schemes\\\\/sfasisd#benefits\\\\\" rel=\\\\\"noopener noreferrer\\\\\">Benefits<\\\\/a><\\\\/h3><ol><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><strong>Financial Assistance: <\\\\/strong>Startups can receive up to \\\\u20b91,00,000\\\\/- for skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis.<\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><strong>Skill Enhancement:<\\\\/strong> Focused training to improve soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills.<\\\\/li><\\\\/ol><h3><a href=\\\\\"https:\\\\/\\\\/www.myscheme.gov.in\\\\/schemes\\\\/sfasisd#eligibility\\\\\" rel=\\\\\"noopener noreferrer\\\\\">Eligibility<\\\\/a><\\\\/h3><ol><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span>Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible.<\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span>The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic.<\\\\/li><\\\\/ol><blockquote><strong><em>Note:<\\\\/em><\\\\/strong><em> Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.<\\\\/em><\\\\/blockquote><h3><a href=\\\\\"https:\\\\/\\\\/www.myscheme.gov.in\\\\/schemes\\\\/sfasisd#exclusions\\\\\" rel=\\\\\"noopener for E-Waste (Management and Handling) authorization in Gujarat involves the following steps:<\\\\/p><h3>1. <strong>Determine Applicability<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h3><p>Identify your role in the e-waste lifecycle, such as producer, manufacturer, refurbisher, dismantler, or recycler, to understand your specific obligations under the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022.<\\\\/p><h3>2. <strong>Prepare Required Documents<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h3><p>You will need to submit the following:<\\\\/p><ol><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span>Duly filled application form<\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span>Site map of the facility location<\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span>Copy of the latest consent order or renewal issued by the Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB)<\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span>Details of the waste to be processed per day<\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span>Categorical description of wastes to be handled<\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span>Access the Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP) of the Government of Gujarat.<\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span>Register or log in to your account.<\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span>Navigate to the \\'Authorization under E-Waste Management Rules\\' section.<\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span>Fill in the required details and upload the necessary documents.<\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span Reporting<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h3><ol><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span>Maintain records of e-waste collected, processed, and data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span>Ensure adherence to safety and environmental standards during e-waste handling and processing.<\\\\/li><\\\\/ol><p>The authorization is typically valid for five years. It is advisable to apply for renewal at least 120 days before expiration to ensure continuity of operations.<\\\\/p><\\\\/div>\",\"68\":null,\"33\":null,\"32\":null,\"31\":null,\"34\":null,\"65\":null,\"17\":null,\"1\":null,\"45\":null,\"75\":null,\"9\":null,\"74\":null,\"2\":null,\"61\":null,\"54\":null,\"60\":null,\"3\":null,\"53\":null,\"23\":null,\"7\":null,\"5\":null,\"6\":null,\"66\":null,\"42\":null,\"44\":null,\"77\":null,\"43\":null,\"76\":null,\"79\":null,\"40\":null,\"62\":null,\"78\":null,\"84\":\"<div class=\\\\\"ql-editor read-mode\\\\\"><h2><strong style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">What is MSME Udyam Registration?<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h2><p><span style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">MSME registration is also called Udyam registration. The entities that fulfil the MSME classification can apply for MSME registration from the government portal, the Udyam portal. The MSME registration is entirely online and can be obtained from the Udyam registration portal. It is not mandatory for MSMEs to obtain this registration, but it is beneficial to get one\\\\u2019s business registered under this because it provides a lot of benefits in terms of taxation, setting up the business, credit facilities, loans etc.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">Over 1 crore registered MSMEs, employing 7.5 crore people, contribute 36% to India\\'s manufacturing and 45% to exports, establishing the country as a global manufacturing hub with their high-quality products.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><h2><strong style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">MSME Registration Eligibility<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h2><p><strong style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">All manufacturing, service industries, wholesale, and retail trade that fulfil the revised MSME classification criteria of annual turnover and investment can apply for MSME registration.<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">&nbsp;Thus, the MSME registration eligibility depends on an entity\\\\u2019s annual turnover and investment. The following entities are eligible for MSME registration:<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><ol><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><span style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">Individuals, startups, business owners, and entrepreneurs<\\\\/span><\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><span style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">Private and public limited companies<\\\\/span><\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><span style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">Sole proprietorship<\\\\/span><\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><span style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">Partnership firm<\\\\/span><\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><span style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs)<\\\\/span><\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><span style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">Self Help Groups (SHGs)<\\\\/span><\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><span style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">Co-operative societies<\\\\/span><\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><span style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">Trusts<\\\\/span><\\\\/li><\\\\/ol><h2><strong style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">Documents Required for MSME Registration<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h2><p><strong style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">The MSME registration&nbsp;<\\\\/strong><strong style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px; background-color: transparent;\\\\\"><a href=\\\\\"https:\\\\/\\\\/cleartax.in\\\\/s\\\\/msme-registration-india-documents-required\\\\\" rel=\\\\\"noopener noreferrer\\\\\">documents<\\\\/a><\\\\/strong><strong style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">&nbsp;are as follows:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/p><ol><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><strong style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">Aadhaar card<\\\\/strong><\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><strong style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">PAN card<\\\\/strong><\\\\/li><\\\\/ol><p><strong style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">There are no MSME registration fees<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"font-size: 13px;\\\\\">&nbsp;and it does not require proof of documents.
